mostWorthwhile.text: Returning nutrients from decomposed wood to the forest made the nutrient cycle clear, from fungal breakdown through soil to root uptake.

leastWorthwhile.text: Inspecting the forest and trying clouds with air produced no progress; the storm route was not yet clear.

surprise.text: Air combined with rainfall, rather than clouds, to make a storm; the inspection performed that combination automatically.

arbitrary.text: Using fallen wood with partnered cells to produce fungi was not obvious to me. The result explained that it represented evolution, not wood turning into an organism.

continue.text: Yes. The linked nutrient, carbon and water cycles were understandable and made me curious about what the next chapter might connect.
